Management promised mid-single-digit value growth and 18 to 20 percent PBDIT margins for FY26. Numbers agreed, as decorative value grew 4.3 percent while consolidated PBDIT margin hit 18.9 percent. Q1 FY27 continued strong momentum with revenue up 18 percent.
Consolidated revenue expanded to ₹58,539 crore in the first quarter of fiscal 2027 with strong profit growth.

Management reported continuous quarterly revenue expansion reaching ₹58,539 crore in the first quarter of fiscal 2027, growing 18.3% year-on-year. Reported profitability aligns with management commentary, driven by strong operational execution across mobile and enterprise segments.

Management met its full-year FY26 revenue guidance of ₹700 crore by delivering ₹713.2 crore. However, free cash flow remains negative at ₹88 crore across four of five years despite rising reported profits.

Management delivered 33% revenue growth in FY26 to ₹3,626 crore. However, results diverged from targets: revenue missed the promised ₹4,000 crore minimum, operating cash flow was −₹600 crore despite guidance to be positive, and working capital reached 122 days versus 70–85 days.
Management revised the Net Working Capital to Revenue target to around 10% by March 2026. 10%

Envisages Rs 30 billion investment into the Semiconductor business during the plan period. ₹3,000 crore

Management targets company growth at 1.5x of market growth. 1.5 x market growth
Project Spring targets investing INR 12 billion to 16 billion annually through FY30. ₹1,200–1,600 crore

Management promised long-term EBITDA margins of 11% to 13%, which aligns with FY26 EBITDA margin of 13.9% and Q2 FY27 margin of 14.4%. However, FMEG Q4 FY26 EBIT margin of 4.1% diverged from the 8% to 10% target before recovering.
Reliance Retail aims to double its EBITDA over the next three years. 2 x market growth
FMCG business targets Rs. 1 lakh crore revenue by FY30. ₹100,000 crore
KGD6 gas price ceiling is expected to rise towards $9.9 in H2 FY27. 9.9 USD
The Kurnool beverage plant will be ready by March 2026.

Management reported strong top-line growth of 25% to 27% in Q1 FY27. However, while management claimed net profit grew 6% to ₹23,200 crore, reported net profit actually declined by 24.6% year-on-year to ₹23,196 crore.
Management expects the acquisition to be EPS accretive from the first 12 months post-closing.
Company expects high single-digit top line growth in FY27. 7–9%
Effective tax rate expected in a similar range as Q1 FY27 until Organon closing. 27.8%

Management promised high single-digit top-line growth for FY27, matching Q1 FY27 revenue growth of 10.1% YoY to ₹15,183.6 crore. However, Q1 FY27 R&D spending at 5.4% of sales lagged the target range of 6% to 7%.

In June 2026 (Q1 FY27 call), management stated its $650 million deal would be "accretive - revenue & margin from Q2 onwards." In October 2026 (Q2 FY27 call), management cited an aspirational margin range of 16% to 17%. For Q2 FY27, revenue grew 30.3% YoY to ₹4,663.9 crore, while EBIT margin stood at 15%.

Management maintained a long-term guidance of a 6% Adjusted EBITDA margin for quick commerce in Q1 FY27, expecting margins to directionally improve. In Q2 FY27, management noted that food delivery margins would likely stay flattish over the next 1-2 years due to growth reinvestments. Q2 FY27 reported an overall EBITDA margin of 3.1%.

In February 2026, management reported gross long-term debt of ~INR 78,000 crores (~$9B) and total external debt of ~INR 62,000 crores. In April 2026, CFO Robbie Singh stated that core infrastructure leverage would track between 3.5x to 4.5x, expecting overall leverage (then at 3.9x) to remain flat or decrease slightly in the next fiscal year.

In May and July 2026 calls, management guided for accelerated revenue growth in FY27 and sequential increases in profitability beyond Q1's 8% EBITDA margin towards 15–20% in the medium term. The Q2 FY27 results match this, delivering 28.5% YoY revenue growth (₹2,648 crore) and an expanded EBITDA margin of 10.2%.
